analysis.title: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp: Refining leverage, scale and diversification push in LNG
key_insights: XOM's 3Q26 results showed record refining performance. Management said underlying unit earnings in energy products have tripled since 2019 on a constant price basis.

XOM is upgrading its US refineries to structurally raise distillate and lubricant yields. RBC says XOM should be well placed to manage oil market volatility and deliver strong capture rates, as it did over the past two quarters.
RBC's margin indicator points to QTD 4Q26 refining margins of $45/bbl for XOM, implying earnings of about $5.5bn.
Middle East outages continue to weigh on upstream. Management guided a ~350kboed impact in 4Q26, concentrated in Qatari LNG.
UAE production is restored, but sales are deferred because of logistics constraints around the SOH. Management expects disruptions to persist 'well through next year.'
XOM announced an asset swap with Eni on Mozambique LNG. XOM now holds 50% of the onshore complex (previously 25%) and Eni gains share in the offshore FLNG project.

RBC sees the Mozambique move as strategically sensible given XOM's record on large, complex developments. The onshore project carries significant risk: it is already significantly delayed and FID is not yet taken (expected by YE26).
Together with a larger stake in Papua LNG, the Mozambique deal suggests XOM is scaling and diversifying its LNG portfolio, perhaps because of its over-concentration in Qatari LNG.
RBC raises 2026E EPS by 6% to $13.25 and 2027E by 4.7% to $9.72, and cuts 2028E by 7.7% to $8.58. Most revisions in outer years come from RBC's new, higher price deck.
On forward pricing XOM trades at 9.4x/10.3x EV/DACF in 2026E/27E versus CVX at 7.7x/7.8x. It offers 7%/6% FCF yields in 2026E/27E versus CVX at 9% in both years.

Sector Perform and $180 price target are maintained. The target rests on 11x 2027E EV/DACF, above XOM's historical average for its core business and above peers, reflecting its defensiveness and returns record.
RBC argues earnings momentum and risk-reward are balanced after continued outperformance. Chemicals margins remain challenged, and the growth story looks recognised in the valuation.
The buyback looks more modest than peers, and RBC expects distributions as a percentage of market cap to lag the peer group.
Scenarios: upside $210 assumes $100/bbl Brent in 2026 and mid-cycle refining and chemicals earnings. Downside $120 assumes $40/bbl Brent and downstream earnings near 2008-09 recession levels.
RBC's comp sheet shows US integrated majors trading at 13.2x 2026E P/E and 8.8x EV/DACF. XOM is at 13.5x P/E and 9.4x EV/DACF, with a 98% of 52-week high reading.

earnings_insights: XOM 3Q26 reported (10/30): record refining performance. 3Q26A net earnings $17,505m per RBC's quarterly table (1Q26A $8,772m, 2Q26A $14,680m, 4Q26E $14,036m, 2026E $54,993m).
RBC 4Q26E estimate: QTD refining margin indicator of $45/bbl implies about $5.5bn of refining earnings. This is an RBC estimate, not a reported figure.
RBC 2026E EPS (ops diluted) $13.25 vs prior $12.51, +5.9%. 2027E $9.72 vs $9.28, +4.7%. 2028E $8.58 vs $9.29, (7.7%). These are RBC estimates.
RBC 2026E Energy Products earnings $16,890m (prior $18,312m, (7.8%)). Upstream 2026E $28,408m (+6.6% vs prior). Chemical Products 2026E $2,739m (+14.0%).
Management guided a ~350kboed Middle East impact for 4Q26, concentrated in Qatari LNG.

risk_factors: Weakness in global oil or gas prices is the largest downside risk.
Delays or budget overruns on major capital projects under construction.
Integration risk if XOM continues to be acquisitive.
Political risk from significant production in unstable parts of the world.
Mozambique LNG onshore project is significantly delayed and FID is not yet taken (expected by YE26).
Challenged chemicals margins against a tough economic backdrop.

tension_points.bull_case: Record 3Q26 refining, tripled underlying unit earnings in energy products since 2019, upgraded refineries and RBC's $45/bbl 4Q26 margin indicator implying about $5.5bn of earnings. Upside scenario is $210.
tension_points.bear_case: Premium valuation (9.4x 2026E EV/DACF vs CVX 7.7x), modest buyback versus peers, challenged chemicals margins and Middle East outages. Downside scenario is $120.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A fall in Brent toward the $40/bbl downside-scenario assumption would break the bull case.
